title: Computation of Liquidated Damages on a Retrofit Project
content:
# Computation of Liquidated Damages on a Retrofit Project

The liquidated damages credited on a project under Equipment Replacement & Retrofit Projects that ran late are worked out from the days of delay, the daily amount the project carries and the ceiling its class puts on the damages.

## Clause 1 — The days of delay

The guaranteed period runs from the day the crew mobilised, and the days of delay are the calendar days from the end of that period to the day the system was accepted as running for its intended use, the last day of the period excluded and the day of acceptance included. The guaranteed period is the period in calendar days the project's class guarantees. The guaranteed period is not extended, so 0 days are added to it. No grace is allowed past the end of the guaranteed period, so 0 days of grace stand between the end of the period and the first day of delay, and the guarantee is not suspended, so 0 days are taken out of the count. Where the days of delay fall below zero they are counted as none.

## Clause 2 — The daily amount

The daily amount is the daily amount the project's class carries, with nothing added to it: 0 USD is added to the class's figure.

## Clause 3 — The damages

The damages are the days of delay multiplied by the daily amount, and they are never more than the ceiling the class puts on them, which is its portion of the contract value; the smaller of the two is credited and the figure is rounded to the nearest cent.

## Worked figures (hypothetical inputs)

A project mobilised on the 1st of a 31-day month, whose class guarantees 120 calendar days, carries a daily amount of USD 450 and a ceiling of 5 per cent of the contract value, with a contract value of USD 900000 and acceptance recorded 134 days after mobilisation:

| Step | Working | Figure |
|---|---|---|
| days from mobilisation to acceptance | as recorded | 134 |
| guaranteed period | the class's period | 120 |
| days of delay | 134 less 120 | 14 |
| damages before the ceiling | 14 days at USD 450 | USD 6300.00 |
| ceiling | 900000 taken at 5 per cent | USD 45000.00 |
| credited | the smaller of the two | USD 6300.00 |

Where acceptance on the same project fell 118 days after mobilisation, the difference is below zero, the days of delay are none and nothing is credited. Where the same project ran 200 days late, the damages before the ceiling would be USD 90000.00 and the figure credited would be the ceiling, USD 45000.00.
